evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.source: data/items.json -> id 8020 "Abyssal Mask" -> passives[0] ("Unmake", unique: true) -> branches[0]
sources_quoted.text: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: +12% MAGIC damage taken; magic-typed only; applies to enemy CHAMPIONS; benefits ALL sources (whole team); UNIQUE passive (one application regardless of how many holders).
Riot's own tooltip restates the amp as magic-typed, confirming it is not a generic all-damage amp.

sources_quoted.source: data/items.json -> id 4005 "Imperial Mandate" -> passives[1] ("Command", unique: true) -> branches[0]
sources_quoted.text: {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: +7% ALL-type damage taken; requires an immobilize on an enemy CHAMPION; benefits ALL sources; subsequent immobilizes EXTEND duration and do NOT stack the amp.

sources_quoted.text: Abilities with {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effects have their cooldown reduced equivalent to {{as|20 ability haste}}.
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: Conditional 20 AH on immobilizing abilities only; separate from the item's flat 15 AH stat line (data/item-atoms/4005.json: stats.ability-power 60, stats.ability-haste 15).

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, Section 1.2 (linearity of expectation, multi-hit abilities)
sources_quoted.text: the mitigation operator `x -> x*100/(100+R)` is *linear in raw damage* for a fixed resistance
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: Because mitigation is linear in raw damage, a multiplicative damage-taken amp factors cleanly out of the per-event sum: the scenario total is exactly (amp factor) x (unamped total) per damage type. This is what makes the ratio analysis below exact rather than approximate.

sources_quoted.text: `f(S)` = the coupled participant-timeline score: deterministic total damage dealt by the main participant before its own death
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: Fixes the semantics of the leaf: cumulative damage accumulated up to the main participant's death time; the `..._team_...` variant is the same functional summed over the main participant's team.

reproducibility_limit: An exact from-scratch recomputation of the absolute number is NOT possible from the permitted evidence tree: the scenario's roster (champions, levels, ability ranks, builds, fight window) lives in scripts/, which this runbook forbids reading, and no golden scenario definition is mirrored under data/ (data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json contains no mandate/abyssal/roster scenario). The computation below is therefore an exact CONSTRAINT analysis on the pair of values: the amp factors are the only free multiplicative structure in the leaf, and mitigation's linearity (math-foundations 1.2) lets that structure be inverted from the ratio alone.

independent_computation.model: Let P = unamped post-mitigation physical+true team damage in the window and M = unamped post-mitigation magic team damage. Under the wiki rules above the CORRECT total is  T = 1.07 * (P + 1.12*M)  -- Vulnerable amps every damage type, Unmake amps only the magic type, each applied once (both are unique passives, and Mandate's repeat immobilizes extend duration rather than stack).

step_1_the_delta_cannot_be_Mandate_typed.argument: Any hypothesis in which the 7% Vulnerable amp alone was added/removed for a subset of sources or events gives ratio = 1 + 0.07*s with s in [0,1], i.e. ratio <= 1.07. Applying the 7% on top of already-curse-amped damage cannot exceed 1.07 either. The observed ratio is 1.07302 > 1.07; solving 0.07*s = 0.07302 needs s = 1.0431 > 1, which is impossible.
step_1_the_delta_cannot_be_Mandate_typed.conclusion: The changed quantity NECESSARILY involves Abyssal Mask's 12% Unmake/Curse amp. A pure Mandate-side change (double-applied Vulnerable, Vulnerable applied without an immobilize, Vulnerable dropped) is arithmetically excluded, since every such change would move the leaf by exactly 1.07x.

step_2_the_delta_is_a_partial_12_percent.argument: The delta is 12%-typed but partial: 222.5 = 0.12 * 1854.17, i.e. exactly one extra 12% Unmake application over a magic sub-total of ~1854.2 post-amp (equivalently ~1655.5 pre-amp). A partial (magic-share-weighted) 12% is precisely the signature of scoping the curse to the magic damage type; a whole-scope change would have produced a round factor (1.12, 1.19 additive, or 1.1984 multiplicative), none of which the ratio matches.

step_3_consistent_reconstruction_of_the_.hypothesis: OLD treated Unmake as a generic all-damage amp (T_old = 1.07 * 1.12 * (P + M)); NEW scopes it to the magic type per the wiki text (T_new = 1.07 * (P + 1.12*M)).
step_3_consistent_reconstruction_of_the_.reading: Both candidate values fall out of one self-consistent pair of underlying damage components; the ONLY difference is whether the 12% curse is typed (magic-only, wiki-correct) or generic (all damage, wiki-incorrect). The new value is the typed one.

step_4_alternative_hypotheses_scored.hypothesis: OLD double-applied the curse (e.g. once per allied Abyssal holder, or once as a target debuff and again as a source amp); NEW applies it once.
step_4_alternative_hypotheses_scored.wiki_ruling: Unmake is flagged "unique": true in data/items.json and is worded as a debuff ON the target ("become cursed ... receive ... from all sources"), so it applies once. Also favours the NEW value.

step_4_alternative_hypotheses_scored.hypothesis: OLD applied the curse to a non-champion target (objective); NEW withholds it.
step_4_alternative_hypotheses_scored.wiki_ruling: Both effects are worded "enemy champions" only. Also favours the NEW value.

step_4_alternative_hypotheses_scored.hypothesis: REGRESSION: NEW wrongly narrowed the curse so it no longer amplifies allied sources, contradicting "from all sources".
step_4_alternative_hypotheses_scored.implied_condition: requires the de-amplified sources' damage to be ~61% of the leaf and entirely magic-typed
step_4_alternative_hypotheses_scored.why_rejected: This is the only story under which the OLD value would be correct, and it is the weakest: (a) it needs the lost sources to be purely magic-typed to hit the observed ratio, whereas the mis-typing story reproduces it with an ordinary mixed 36/64 magic/physical roster; (b) the scenario is named for the roster-wide curse, so a change that deleted roster-wide propagation would defeat the scenario's own purpose rather than be pinned as the new baseline; (c) losing propagation for a source would drop BOTH amps for that source (a 1.1984x-shaped loss), while the observed delta is cleanly a single 12%-typed application.

conclusion: The wiki cache is unambiguous on the two rules that govern this leaf: Abyssal Mask's Unmake is a UNIQUE, magic-typed, champion-only +12% damage-taken debuff that benefits all sources, and Imperial Mandate's Command is a UNIQUE, all-type, champion-only +7% damage-taken debuff whose repeat immobilizes extend duration rather than stack. Arithmetic on the pair proves the change is 12%-typed and partial (a pure Mandate-side change is impossible, since it could only move the leaf by exactly 1.07x). A single self-consistent decomposition -- unamped team damage 2728.3, of which 995.4 magic (36.5%) -- yields the OLD value when the 12% curse is applied to ALL damage and the NEW value when it is applied to MAGIC damage only, as the wiki text and Riot's own tooltip require. Every rule-tightening hypothesis consistent with the ratio (magic-only typing, single application of a unique passive, champions-only targeting) points the same way.
residual_uncertainty: Medium-low. The absolute number could not be recomputed end-to-end because the scenario's roster/build definition is outside the permitted evidence tree; the verdict rests on (i) an exact exclusion of any Mandate-only explanation, and (ii) the wiki-text ruling that Unmake is magic-typed, unique, and champion-scoped. If a reader with access to the scenario config finds that the change instead removed the curse's amplification of ALLIED damage, that would be a regression and the verdict would flip to old_value_correct -- that is the single hypothesis this evidence tree cannot fully exclude.
